limitations: Dense curves have measured nonzero display error; source envelopes and original polyline limits are separate checks.
R tied timestamp ordering is not emulated; its effect is separately quantified and bounded by observed tied yield.
No pixel identity; native 15-minute views remain unchanged.
Optional hourly zero fill rejects last hour >100000.
Synthetic resource measurements are single executions on macOS arm64, uncontrolled cache/load; no real 11GB/HPC benchmark.
Browser screenshot verification not performed; actual exported PNG/gallery figures inspected separately.
